title: Keep trajectory.json as the sole trajectory artifact
intent: Remove durable trajectory-runs archive writes and loaders. Keep .decapod/governance/trajectory.json as the sole current and committed trajectory artifact, with Git commit, branch, issue, and PR history providing historical context. Preserve atomic replacement, same-run protection, proof binding, path normalization, and agent-facing contracts.
stop_conditions: trajectory.json remains the only trajectory artifact written or loaded by runtime code
Git history and linked issue or PR context remain the historical lookup mechanism
Do not bypass Decapod-owned state boundaries or directly mutate machine-owned control-plane artifacts
